nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon Public Marketplace Data: alexa Search API.

format.description: Response format: `markdown` returns a readable report; `json` returns a structured data array.

prompts.description: An array of dialogue prompts with a length within 255 characters, only 1 is supported; only 1 question can be passed in for each call. When asking across times, the agent needs to summarize the context of the previous round and pass it in as a new `prompts[0]`.

url.description: A specific category page, search results page, or product detail page URL that is used to supplement the Alexa page context; do not pass the Amazon homepage URL.

name: nexscope_data_amazon_alexa_search
title: Amazon Public Marketplace Data: alexa Search API
